About This Tool

The Depreciation Calculator is a free browser-based utility simplify asset depreciation calculations for accountants, business owners, and tax professionals. Whether you need a quick straight-line calculation or a full MACRS schedule with Section 179 analysis, this tool provides accurate results instantly without downloads, installations, or sign-ups.

by Michael Lip, this tool runs 100% client-side in your browser. No data is ever sent to any server, and nothing is stored or tracked. Your privacy is fully preserved every time you use it.
